From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarita Reddy <sarita@finco.com>, contracts@finco.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order Form — party roster, billing lead, SOW attachments and initial redline window

Hi Sarita / FinCo procurement team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attaching our proposed MSA and the draft Order Form + SOW for the Datapipelines project so legal can start their pass. To keep momentum, can you confirm the items below so we can align internal owners and dispatch a contract redline window?

Attachments: [Redwood_MSA_v1.2.docx (docx)], [OrderForm-FinCo.xlsx (xlsx)], [SOW-Datapipelines.pdf (pdf)]

Quick asks:
- Billing lead: who should receive invoices / PO and what billing contact should we list on Exhibit B?
- Signatory authority: who is the signing authority on your side (name, title, email) — we heard Tom Ellis (VP Finance) on the call but want to confirm.
- Security evidence: do you need our SOC 2 report or a short attestation? If you have a procurement checklist, please attach.
- Timing: we typically ask for a 3-business-day initial redline turnaround from legal to keep the demo schedule. Is that feasible?

Internal owners: Kimberly (legal) will lead the redline pass; Marissa (CS) will validate SOW scope/acceptance criteria.

Next steps: once we have the billing contact + signer confirmed we’ll push the MSA to legal and share a tracked-redline back to you.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

--
[attachment: Redwood_MSA_v1.2.docx]
[attachment: OrderForm-FinCo.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarita Reddy <sarita@finco.com>, contracts@finco.com
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — party roster, billing lead, SOW attachments and initial redline window

Jonas / Sarita —

Thanks, attaching initial checklist we use for vendor intake so nothing falls through the cracks on our side. A few clarifying items before I start the legal redline: 

1) Billing and PO flow: please confirm if FinCo requires a PO prior to signature and provide the AP email for invoicing. If you prefer billing through a third-party, let us know the entity name to include on Exhibit B.

2) Residency & data handling: the SOW references pipeline transforms in us-west. If FinCo has specific residency or encryption requirements, flag them now — we’ll map to our data processing addendum.

3) Security evidence: Jonas mentioned SOC 2 — we can provide our report + attestation. If you have a procurement checklist or specific evidence (e.g., IP whitelisting, penetration test report) attach.

4) Term / SLA exceptions: If your team expects material changes to the SLA or uptime targets, highlight those items so legal can model the amendment rather than redline line-by-line.

Timing note: I’ll aim for a tracked-redline back to you by Tue, 20 May (3 business days) assuming no material counterparty exceptions. If FinCo needs more time, please propose a window.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Hi Jonas / Kimberly —

Thanks for sending these over. Answers below: 

- Billing / PO: please bill to FinCo AP — ap@finco.com. We will raise a PO after agreement signature; PO number will be added to the first invoice.
- Signer: confirmed — Tom Ellis (VP Finance) will sign on behalf of FinCo. Main contact for signatures: tom.ellis@finco.com.
- Security evidence: attached procurement checklist and our security requirements doc. We reviewed your SOC 2 mention and will need the report + the attestation page.
- Residency: us-west is fine. No additional residency constraints for this engagement.
- Timeline: 3 business days for an initial redline is tight but acceptable; if legal needs more time we’ll accommodate. Our internal procurement turnaround after your redline will be ~5 business days.

Attachments: [FinCo-Security-Requirements.pdf]

Let us know if you want us to route the final agreement through DocuSign or if you prefer a signed PDF.

Thanks,
Sarita Reddy
Senior Procurement Manager, FinCo
sarita@finco.com

Kimberly / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick clarifications, and thanks Sarita for the procurement doc. Confirming internal plan and next steps: 

Action items
- Kimberly: legal redline of Redwood_MSA_v1.2.docx + modest edits to OrderForm-FinCo.xlsx. Target: Tue, 20 May EOD (3 business days).
- Marissa: review SOW-Datapipelines.pdf for acceptance criteria and deliverable milestones; flag any scope gaps by Mon, 19 May.
- Jonas: after Kimberly’s redline I’ll send a single tracked copy to sarita@finco.com and tom.ellis@finco.com. We’ll propose DocuSign routing for signature unless FinCo prefers otherwise.

Notes for legal redline: limit changes to (i) Exhibit B billing info (ap@finco.com), (ii) signature block (Tom Ellis), (iii) data addendum cross-reference. If material SLA changes are requested we’ll surface to product for feasibility.

I’ll update the HubSpot deal (RWI-2025-FIN-042) with the procurement timeline and attach the FinCo security doc for records.

Thanks —
